notes.title: Our Game Masocats - Official Release
notes.content:
We finish a big game project in my school. During 3 months we work on this project of couch game. I work as Game Artist in this project (Environnement Artist, Props Artists, UI Artist and VFX Artist) 

I work with wonderful team and our project is really cool. It is couch game, you can play with yours friends (2 until 4)

[b]Our Game is called Masocats[/b]

[i]"Be the first one to suffer the most for the fame. Masochistic bodybuilder cats seek to be the one to receive the most pain in an arena. To do so, the arena will give you painful trap & items on all the map.

Use the various recoverable power-ups on the map to "help" your opponents not to get hurt. Help and hinder them to obtain victory in suffering."[/i]

[b]Controls : [/b]

Right Shoulder : Push other players and objects

Left Joystick : Movement

Depending on the controller ( A (XBox), X (Playstation), B (Switch) ) : Throw objects

notes.title: About Future Update
notes.content:
Hi it been 2 weeks, the early access is officially released, a lot of people i know test the game. I prepare a big update who fixing and add somes changes. 

Before explainining i i make a new video where i show the evolution of my game since 2021 
[previewyoutube=SsalUwoOy3U;full][/previewyoutube]

For future update, i see a lot of bugs like sliding in somes walls, music who stop, somes physics bugs so i will try to fix them. I m planned to fixed balancing of game, i think level 1 is too hard for beginners, i will arrange that. I need to arrange somes boss patterns, i try to add more animated ennemies and make script for make breathing, ennemies who are just an image sprite. I will start to work on 3 difficulty mod, there will not affect patterns and ennemies, it will affect player : 

- [b]normal mod[/b] : default mode, player has 6 lives and no bonus, demeter tree for save and load are still accessible 
- [b]assist mod[/b] : a mod for beginner players, in this mod player has 15 lives and your projectiles scale and damage limits are increased, projectiles will stay longer 
- [b]god mod[/b] : the players has choice of 2 options : 1 lives or no demeter tree for save and load, the player can also activate the two option at the same time

this mod are not really necessarly, it just for add challenge and inclusion, adapt to all type of players

THANKS YOU A LOT FOR READING THIS ARTICLE AND FOR SUPPORT MY GAME

notes.title: ORPHEUS - Early Access Release
notes.content:
Hi everyone, i m an indie developper and i want to present you my 1st project. I finally release the early access of my game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222725/b1f55756efe36f784ae37c643192b83305b40077.png[/img]

Orpheus is a project for my 3rd year of Art University and my first game on STEAM. In this game you play as Orpheus from the greek myth, you should rescue Eurydice who is dead. And you will go to the Hell for saving her.

For achieve this, you should cross the 5 levels of Hell and fight differents boss. Orpheus is a platformer game when the player had a lyre who can shoot a projectiles, projectiles are sounds in reality, it will bounce on obstacle and make damage to enemies, more the bullet bounce, more you make damage to differents ennmies. Play with bounce to make maximum of damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222725/29309618ca3e0d17d6b346f5aea88766d451309b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222725/c428ad8ce068a16aeb8cca6d9080717e73317bc2.png[/img]

Currently in this early access there is 2 levels and a part of level 3, you have one functionnal weapon in inventory and somes ennemies are not implemented. But don t worry i continue to work hard to finish the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222725/4e6152a2ab1d98d77dbe09ec74abace97d12fcdb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222725/0ede77c6d7cead642c02d2365c507989c95366c6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222725/c0a0f040cd4783640f1833cee50fa8797e8616a4.jpg[/img]

I continue to work on the game but i can feel, i passed an important step. I have a ton of things to improve i know but the game is stable, i will probably make fixing bugs update in next days. For now i use existing music (touhou or hollow knight) but don t worry i will compose an original ost for the final game.

Thanks you so much for reading this page and don't hesitate to test the game and give me your opinion :)

Don't hesitate to look the trailer :)
